prompt: Hyper-realistic photograph of the world's most detailed surreal sculpture, a mix of Gaudi and Magritte. A man and a woman sculpture embraced, expressing their love through touches. The material diversity is enormous: The man figure is made of polished black marble, wood carvings, and Gaudi-style mosaic remnants. The woman figure consists of soft-textured limestone, polished bronze, and a transparent void symbolizing Magritte-style invisibility. The mosaic hand is touching the marble shoulder. The sculpture itself stands on a twisted, colorful ceramic pedestal like in Gaudi's Park Güell. In the background, Magritte's iconic night/day contrasting sky. Flawless photorealism, macro texture details, studio lighting, ultra-high resolution, render. --chaos 25 --ar 9:16 --profile 2jr9z1n --v 8.1
